name: line-chart
title: Line chart
description: Up to five series over time as lines, for comparing trends.

when: Comparing a few series over the same periods.

keyboard.does: Moves between data points; the tooltip follows.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.

genui.description: Up to five series compared over time. Rows are periods; categories are the numeric columns.
